cases.prompt: 在当前项目的 docs 目录创建 onboarding.md，并写入我给出的入门步骤。
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect the destination, create the text file, re-read it, and report verification.

cases.prompt: 请修改 ./config/app.yaml，把 timeout 从 20 调成 30，其他配置保持不变。
cases.expected_behavior: Read the existing file, apply one precise edit, and verify the changed region.

cases.prompt: 继续完善 /workspace/guide.md，先读取现在的内容，再补上排错章节。
cases.expected_behavior: Treat disk state as authoritative before continuing the file.

cases.prompt: 读取 src/settings.ts，告诉我默认重试次数在哪里定义。
cases.expected_behavior: Read the exact local text file without modifying it.

cases.prompt: 把 README 里旧的启动命令换成 pnpm dev，别碰其他段落。
cases.expected_behavior: Infer a precise existing-file update and preserve unrelated content.

cases.prompt: 上次那份本地说明稿还没写完，请以文件现在的版本为准接着补。
cases.expected_behavior: Locate the referenced workspace file only if sufficiently identifiable, then re-read before editing.

cases.prompt: 帮这个仓库落一份新的 .editorconfig，内容按我下面的规则来。
cases.expected_behavior: Create a requested local configuration text file after checking whether it exists.

cases.prompt: 删除项目里所有过期的 .log 文件。
cases.expected_behavior: Do not use this skill because deletion is outside scope.

cases.prompt: 把 Downloads 里的照片按日期批量重命名。
cases.expected_behavior: Do not use this skill because personal-directory organization and batch rename are outside scope.

cases.prompt: 修改这份 Excel，把第二列格式改成百分比。
把合同 PDF 的第三页删掉。
cases.expected_behavior: Route to the PDF skill and do not perform deletion here.

cases.prompt: 更新我的腾讯文档周报。
cases.expected_behavior: Route to the relevant cloud-document connector or skill.

cases.prompt: 在 /tmp/demo-note.md 写一行测试内容。
cases.expected_behavior: Recognize the explicit outside-workspace path, restrict authorization to that exact target, then verify the write.

cases.prompt: 只修改 /workspace/.env 里的 APP_PORT，不要显示或更改其他变量。
cases.expected_behavior: Treat the exact file as sensitive, minimize exposure, preserve other secrets, and verify without echoing values.
